name: ble.sh (Bash Line Editor)
summary: Pure-Bash replacement for GNU Readline adding syntax highlighting, fish-style auto-complete suggestions, menu completion, vim mode and transient-prompt hooks.
configFormat: bash script (~/.blerc or ~/.config/blesh/init.sh) using bleopt, ble-face, ble-bind
startupCostMs: Measured on this Windows 11 machine in Git Bash: 24-60 ms per keystroke and ~0.9 s per new tab. Not recommended on Windows. On Linux/macOS it is acceptable but still adds shell-start time and per-key work since it is written in Bash.

detect: for f in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/blesh/ble.sh" /usr/share/blesh/ble.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && { grep -m1 -oE "ble-[0-9][0-9.]*" "$f" || echo present; exit; }; done
windows.notes: Works in Git Bash (MSYS2) but NOT RECOMMENDED: machine-measured 24-60 ms per keystroke and ~0.9 s per new tab. Prefer PowerShell with PSReadLine 2.2+ (inline predictions, no per-key script cost) or zsh/fish on WSL. If you still want it: nightly tarball + `bash ble-nightly/ble.sh --install ~/.local/share` (needs curl, tar with xz).

detect: for f in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/blesh/ble.sh" /usr/share/blesh/ble.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && { grep -m1 -oE "ble-[0-9][0-9.]*" "$f" || echo present; exit; }; done
macos.notes: Not in Homebrew core (checked 2026-11-23). Install from git or the nightly tarball. /bin/bash is 3.2: ble.sh runs but auto-complete and menu-filter need bash 4.0+, so `brew install bash` and make it your shell first. macOS awk may mishandle multibyte text; README suggests gawk.

install.notes: Debian forky/sid only (0.4.0~git20250806); not in trixie. Elsewhere use git/nightly.

detect: for f in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/blesh/ble.sh" /usr/share/blesh/ble.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && { grep -m1 -oE "ble-[0-9][0-9.]*" "$f" || echo present; exit; }; done
linux.notes: Arch: AUR `blesh-git` (not in official repos). Generic: `git clone --recursive --depth 1 --shallow-submodules https://github.com/akinomyoga/ble.sh.git && make -C ble.sh install PREFIX=~/.local` (needs git, GNU make, GNU awk), then source ~/.local/share/blesh/ble.sh from ~/.bashrc. Nightly tarball: https://github.com/akinomyoga/ble.sh/releases/tag/nightly. Update: `ble-update` or `bash ble.sh --update` (0.4+).

performance.notes: Documents the cost; this is the tool's main drawback on Windows.

sources: keystroke/tab timings measured on this machine (Git Bash, 2026-11-23)
